title: Rank-9 realisations of the E8 pattern are B-form or the A2 family (classification; no κ claim)
body:
Adds only `research/e8-rank9-realisations/`. **No κ claim**, no decoder cost, no window or supplier. **E8 only.**

**Result.** Over a field of characteristic 0, every `120 × 120` matrix `M` indexed by the E8 lines with `rank M = 9`, `M_tt ≠ 0` and `M_ts = 0 ⇔ t ⊥ s` (t ≠ s) is **B-form** (`D₁GD₂ + cβᵀ`, rank-one biclique with `c_uβ_s = 0` on orthogonal pairs) **or in the A2 family** of #2784. Both families occur (exact members in `checks/a2e8.py`). This is the existence step ("Conjecture B\*") that #2784 left open.

- **PROVEN** from: Theorem G (CONJB / #2784 §3; span facts S1, S2 CHECKED), Theorem P (pinning) and Theorem A (an orthogonal pair in `Σ_a` or `Σ_b`; all 2025 E8 frames P-compatible, all 3780 orthogonal pairs in a frame, CHECKED), Theorem S, Theorem Σ, Theorem R.
- **Theorem S** (`Σ_a ∩ Σ_b ≠ ∅`): reduction PROVEN; finite step = a 56-line point/line incidence problem, CHECKED: kissat 4.0.4 UNSAT, standard drat-trim VERIFIED, regenerated by `verify.sh` for `f₁ = 0..15` (all 120 under `FULL=1`).
- **Theorem Σ** (`Σ_a ≠ ∅` or `Σ_b ≠ ∅`): PROVEN from S, A, G and CHECKED (S3′), (W2).
- **Theorem R** (`Σ_a = Σ_b = ∅` is empty): reduction PROVEN; finite step CHECKED: the pinning-model CNF (56 784 variables, 3 513 012 clauses) is regenerated byte-identically (sha256 pinned), kissat UNSAT with `--factor=false --preprocessfactor=false`, DRAT proof shipped xz-compressed (11.7 MB; 163 MB raw, sha256 pinned), standard drat-trim VERIFIED (shipped proof: 137 s). `FULL=1` also re-solves (≤ 20 min) and drat-trims a fresh proof. The auxiliary C checker `rupc.c` (RUP-only, deletions honoured, RAT rejected) agrees; drat-trim is the reference.
- Rule soundness of the model: one-line proofs in the card text; `soundtest.py` finds 0 violated clauses on true data (A2 members, 5 parameter draws on 5 triangles; B-form), and a mutation control (one flipped sign) is caught.
- Independent read-only audit: re-verified both certificates with drat-trim, regenerated the CNFs byte-identically, confirmed the soundness test catches a flipped rule (RECORDED; the two fixes it asked for are applied: characteristic 0 is stated, the A2 parameter is varied).

**Downstream (case (c) on E8).** With #2784 (A2-family floors, E8 ≥ 72), case (c) reduces to decoders on B-form realisations. Closed there: A2 family (#2784). For B-form, the working cards (not shipped) have: a term with `p ∝ c` and `q ∝ β` costs ≥ 64; `|supp c| = 1` (the #2321 / #2385 `K_λ` family) ≥ 64 modulo a CHECKED puncture census; the generic 8-clique type ≥ 65 for sampled values. **Not closed:** B-form with all `x_j, y_j ≠ 0` and `|supp c| ≥ 2`, non-generic `c, β`, singular `D`, `m ≥ 10`. So the E8 floor 72 for all rank-9 square decoders is **not** proven.

**Relation to philippeVV's open item (R1)** (Discussion #1587, follow-up 8, `decoder-law/lift-family-2` @ 93766d7d: "every rank-9 completion is a lift"). The lift normal form, credit machinery and census are theirs; nothing here uses them. Their completions (`decoder-law/README.md`) have `N_aa = 1`, `N_ab = 0` for `a ⊥ b` and non-orthogonal entries **free** (zeros allowed), a larger class than our iff pattern; our theorem covers only completions with all non-orthogonal entries nonzero. It would give R1 for that subclass only if every B-form and A2 realisation is a κ-lift, which we have not compared (their R3 covers dependent supports). So R1 does **not** follow. Remaining for R1: (i) show B-form ∪ A2 ⊆ lifts; (ii) drop the iff assumption: Theorem G survives (CONJB §5), but pinning (Theorem P), the NON rule and the S-step use nonzero entries, so both SAT models must be rebuilt and re-certified. Not attempted.

**Not claimed.** P112 / P104 (P112 Theorem R certification is in progress and nothing is claimed; P104 has few P-compatible frames); positive characteristic; formal-kernel check.

**Overlap.** A search of PR bodies for rank-9 / rank-nine realisation classifications found none besides #2784 (A2 family, same author) and #1212 (rank 8 only).

Verify: `bash verify.sh [outdir]` (numpy, sympy, kissat 4.0.4, drat-trim, cc, xz); default run re-solves and drat-trims the Theorem S step, regenerates and hash-checks both CNFs, checks the shipped proof's hash, and runs the soundness test; `FULL=1` adds the Theorem R re-solve and drat-trim.
